parameters.name: Enabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the origin address pool is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The origin address pool ID. You can call the [ListOriginPools](~~ListOriginPools~~) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Origins
parameters.description: The origin server information added to the origin address pool. Use an array to pass multiple origin servers.

sub_parameters.name: Address
sub_parameters.description: The addresses of the origin server, such as www.example.com.

sub_parameters.name: AuthConf
sub_parameters.description: The authentication information. This parameter is required when the origin server is OSS, S3, or another origin server that requires authentication.

sub_parameters.name: Enabled
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether the origin server is enabled. Valid values:

- true: Enabled.
- false: Not enabled.

sub_parameters.name: Header
sub_parameters.description: The request header included in back-to-origin requests. Only Host is supported.

sub_parameters.name: IpVersionPolicy
sub_parameters.description:
The IP protocol version used for back-to-origin requests. Valid values:
- round_robin: default policy. Randomly polls IPv4 or IPv6 origin servers.
- ipv4_first: preferentially uses IPv4 origin servers.
- ipv6_first: preferentially uses IPv6 origin servers.
- follow: preferentially follows the IP version used by the client.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The origin server name. The name must be unique within an origin address pool.

sub_parameters.name: Type
sub_parameters.description:
The origin server type. Valid values:

- ip_domain: an IP address or domain name-based origin server.
- OSS: an OSS address-based origin server.
- S3: an AWS S3 origin server.

sub_parameters.name: Weight
sub_parameters.description: The weight. The value is an integer from 0 to 100.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the ID.
